g.text: Every process that reads or changes a Restricted data asset, with the kind of access on the line. This is the list a data protection review starts from, kept current from the model rather than gathered by interview.

g.title: Test credit decisions and pricing for fair lending
Screen transactions and parties against sanctions in line
Set and deploy credit decision strategy
Set deposit rates and product terms
Open and fund direct deposit account
Issue brokered CDs through the broker network
Settle brokered CDs and keep the position
Process CD maturity, renewal, and early withdrawal
Administer deposit insurance records and escheatment
Detect and action transaction fraud alert
Detect and act on first-party fraud and bust-out
Monitor dealer performance and program compliance
Decide indirect loan and return terms
Review contract package and clear stipulations
Bill installment loan and post payments
Assign repossession and send required notices
Remarket recovered collateral and pursue deficiency
Cancel ancillary products and refund unearned premium
Verify applicant identity and satisfy CIP
Ingest clearing file and post transactions
Operate stand-in authorization during a host outage
Maintain authorization routing and network connectivity
Assess interest, fees, and minimum payment
Close account and settle final balance
Refund credit balance and report unclaimed property
